goal: Karen's Cafe & Gifts in Harrison Hot Springs is already beloved. Guests describe it as going to a grandmother's house, word of mouth brings people in from Vancouver, Chilliwack, Mission and beyond, and the experience earns real loyalty every time someone walks through the door. The problem is that almost none of that warmth is visible before someone arrives. The full offering -- a children's playroom, a private event room, crafting evenings, a garden that holds up to 100 guests, a gift shop -- is invisible online. The current WordPress website does not mention the playroom. There is no dedicated bar or event section. Past attempts at Google Ads and hired website help did not produce clear results because the foundation they needed was not in place. The next ninety days fix that. The goal is to make Karen's Cafe as discoverable online as it is well-regarded in person: accurate and consistent listings across every platform, a social media content system that runs without Karen, and a website that answers the questions visitors are already asking AI tools and search engines before they plan a trip to Harrison.

weeks.title: Week 1: Google Business Profile
actions: Go to business.google.com and claim or access the Karen's Cafe listing → links to: Tactic 1 / Step 1
Complete every profile field: description mentioning all five offerings, hours including closed days, phone number, and website URL → links to: Tactic 1 / Step 2
Enable business attributes: good for kids, outdoor seating, private dining room, family-friendly → links to: Tactic 1 / Step 3
Upload at least 10 photos covering tea service, playroom, garden, and the event room → links to: Tactic 1 / Step 4
Identify and brief the social media helper; share the five content pillars table → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 6
checklist: GBP is claimed and all fields are complete
Business description names the playroom, events, garden, and event space
At least 10 photos are uploaded to the GBP
Social media helper has the five content pillars table in hand

weeks.title: Week 2: Reviews, TripAdvisor, and the Content Library
actions: Write three review response templates (positive, general, negative or mixed) and save them in a Google Doc → links to: Tactic 1 / Step 5
Respond to all Google reviews from the past six months that have not yet received a response → links to: Tactic 1 / Step 5
Claim TripAdvisor listing; update description, hours, and photos to match GBP → links to: Tactic 1 / Step 6
Claim or update Yelp listing; confirm name, address, and phone match Google exactly → links to: Tactic 1 / Step 6
Create the Google Drive Content Library with five pillar sub-folders; helper begins first capture session → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 2
checklist: Review response templates are saved and shared with whoever manages reviews
All reviews from the past 6 months have a response
TripAdvisor listing is claimed and updated
Google Drive Content Library exists with at least 10 photos uploaded by end of week

weeks.title: Week 3: Social Launch and Directory Check

Helper publishes first three posts: one Tea and Table, one Playroom, one Events and Crafting → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 1
Schedule next week's three posts in Meta Business Suite using library assets → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 4
Search "Karen's Cafe & Gifts Harrison Hot Springs" in Google and audit all other directory listings → links to: Tactic 1 / Step 7
Contact previous WordPress developer to retrieve login credentials and hosting details → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 1
checklist: Meta Business Suite shows Facebook and Instagram connected
Three posts are live across Instagram and Facebook
Next week's three posts are scheduled in advance
Directory audit is done and any incorrect listings are flagged for correction
WordPress credential recovery is underway

weeks.title: Week 4: TikTok and Posting Rhythm

Post first TikTok using repurposed Reel content, prioritising crafting event or playroom footage → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 5
Maintain three-post-per-week cadence on Instagram and Facebook with no missed posts → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 4
Log in to WordPress admin; confirm access; change password and save credentials securely → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 1
Review library: are all five pillar sub-folders populated? Identify any gaps → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 2
checklist: TikTok Business account is live with first post published
Instagram and Facebook have maintained 3 posts per week with no gaps
WordPress login is confirmed working
Content library has 20+ photos and at least 5 video clips

weeks.title: Week 5: FAQ Section Draft
actions: Write FAQ content for homepage: 7 questions with direct, complete first-sentence answers → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 3
Add FAQ section to WordPress homepage using H3 headings for questions and paragraph blocks for answers → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 3
Continue 3-4 posts per week; helper posts independently this week with no direction from Karen → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 4
Check Instagram Insights: which posts from Month 1 earned the most saves? → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 4
checklist: FAQ section is live on the WordPress homepage with at least 7 questions
Each FAQ answer begins with a direct, complete response in the first sentence
Helper posted independently this week without input from Karen
Instagram Insights reviewed; top-performing post format identified

weeks.title: Week 6: Playroom and Garden Pages
actions: Add or update the Playroom page on the website: description, one photo, what parents can do → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 4
Add or update the Garden page: capacity, event types, enquiry prompt, and the note that it is one of the only garden event spaces in Harrison → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 4
Confirm Karen's Cafe is listed accurately on the Harrison Tourism website → links to: Tactic 1 / Step 7
Capture a crafting event this week: process video from start to finish for Reels content → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 3
Respond to any new Google or TripAdvisor reviews within 5 business days → links to: Tactic 1 / Step 5
checklist: Playroom and Garden pages are live on the website with descriptions and photos
Harrison Tourism listing is confirmed and current
At least one crafting process video is in the content library
All new reviews have a response

actions: Add Events and Crafting page: types of events, how to book, upcoming dates if scheduled → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 4
Add Private Event Room section: capacity, event types, contact prompt → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 4
Run first AI search test: ask ChatGPT and Perplexity "good cafes Harrison Hot Springs" and "things to do Harrison with kids"; record results → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 5
Connect Google Search Console to the WordPress site and verify ownership → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 6
Continue 3-4 posts per week; include at least one Reel this week → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 4
checklist: Events and Private Event Room content is live on the website
AI search test results are recorded in a document for comparison at 90 days
Google Search Console is connected and confirmed receiving data
At least one Reel published this week

weeks.title: Week 8: WordPress Cheat Sheet and 30-Day Review
actions: Document the basic WordPress update process in a one-page cheat sheet: how to edit a page, how to add a photo, how to update hours → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 2
Review 30-day social performance: which pillar content has the most saves? Which format earned more reach? → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 4
Update any GBP, TripAdvisor, or Yelp information that has changed since Weeks 1-2 → links to: Tactic 1 / Step 7
Respond to all new reviews on all three platforms → links to: Tactic 1 / Step 5

30-day social performance review is completed with notes recorded
All listing platforms reviewed for accuracy
Garden and Gifts posts are live

weeks.title: Week 9: SEO Check-In
actions: Open Google Search Console: which queries are bringing people to the site? Are playroom, garden, or tea-related terms appearing? → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 6
If a query is visible but the page is ranking low, check that page and strengthen the heading and first paragraph → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 4
Run Google search test: "afternoon tea Harrison Hot Springs" and "cafe with children's playroom Harrison"; note position
Continue 3-4 posts per week; helper posts independently with no direction
Refill content library if any sub-folder has fewer than 2 weeks of assets remaining → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 3
checklist: Google Search Console review completed; top 5 queries recorded
At least one low-performing page has been reviewed and strengthened
Search position for "afternoon tea Harrison Hot Springs" is recorded
All five library sub-folders have at least 2 weeks of unused assets

weeks.title: Week 10: Booking Funnel Review
actions: Review how crafting events and private event enquiries are currently handled: is there a contact form, a booking email, or a phone number? → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 4
If there is no clear booking path for events, add a simple contact form to the Events page using WPForms Lite or Contact Form 7 → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 4
Post two event-focused content pieces this week to test engagement → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 1
Run second AI search test using the same queries as Week 7; compare results → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 5
Check TikTok: which video has the most views? Note the topic and format → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 5
checklist: Events page has a clear enquiry path: form, email, or phone prominently displayed
Second AI search test results recorded and compared to Week 7 baseline
TikTok top-performing video identified and noted for format replication

weeks.title: Week 11: Shoulder Season Content Push
actions: Create posts specifically designed for shoulder-season visitors: rainy day tea, cozy winter crafting evenings, garden bookings for spring → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 1
Write and publish a short blog post on the WordPress site: "What to do in Harrison Hot Springs in Winter" with Karen's Cafe featured prominently → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 4
Share the blog post on Facebook and Instagram as a link post with a photo → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 4
Review all GBP, TripAdvisor, and Yelp listings for winter hours accuracy → links to: Tactic 1 / Step 2
Confirm helper is fully independent: can they run a week of content without any input from Karen?
checklist: Four shoulder-season posts are scheduled in Meta Business Suite
Blog post on "Harrison Hot Springs in Winter" is live on the website and shared on social

Helper successfully completed one full week without Karen's involvement

weeks.title: Week 12: Review and Plan Forward
actions: Run final AI search test (ChatGPT and Perplexity): compare results to Weeks 7 and 10 → links to: Tactic 3 / Step 5
Pull 90-day social performance summary from Instagram Insights: follower growth, top post by reach, top post by saves, Reel reach versus photo reach → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 4
Check Google review count: how many new reviews since Week 1? What is the current rating? → links to: Tactic 1 / Step 5
Document three things working well and one thing to change in the next 90 days
Decide whether a professional content session -- photographer or content creator partnership -- is the right next investment → links to: Tactic 2 / Step 2
checklist: Final AI search test completed; improvement from Week 7 baseline is visible or noted
90-day social summary exists with specific numbers
New Google review count since start of program is recorded
Next 90-day priority is decided with a written rationale
